why: AppVerifier and IzzyOnDroid's AllowedAPKSigningKeys both key off this digest, and a sideloading user has no other way to tell an official Aura build from a re-signed one. It had only ever appeared in release notes, which are not a place a gate or a store can read.

rbtlog.note: Registration is owner-gated and follows the IzzyOnDroid submission decision, which is itself gated on the 30 MB per-APK ceiling. tools/foss_reproducibility_check.py is the recipe that would back it.
